protocol.name: multiseed-recall-controls-v2-8k-matched
protocol.hypothesis: If the 1.5B advantage replicates on genuinely unseen seeds with length-matched 8K positive and 8K absent controls, it is not a seed artifact or a length confound.
protocol.design: Same structure as v1 (one initial positive retrieval, two paired follow-ups sharing its actual assistant response, one absent-record control per seed; fresh KV cache per generation; follow-up order alternates by seed), except the initial budget is 8192 so positive retrieval is tested at the same length as the absent control. Seeds 1000033/1000037/1000039 have never been used in this repo. No prompt tuning after observing results.
protocol.scoring: Use the existing case-insensitive exact-answer normalization. Report each seed and paired follow-up outcomes conditional on correct initial retrieval.

spec.name: qwen2.5-1.5b-instruct-q4_k_m-recall-controls
spec.comparison_note: Same recall-controls protocol, prompt token IDs and settings as the 0.5B runs; only the model size differs. Runtime and weight precision both differ from any HF run. This does not isolate an architectural speedup.
